name: Madmanna
title: Entry in Caleb's genealogy
summary: Madmanna is mentioned in the genealogy of Judah among the descendants of Caleb through his concubine Ma'aka, as a namesake for a city in southern Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Caleb's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Madmanna is listed among the descendants of Caleb in the genealogy of Judah.
